method: All prospective tracked/untracked submission files, excluding task inputs and scratch, packed as one isolated temporary Git snapshot. Dependencies and caches excluded. Source repository Git metadata unchanged.
limitation: The source checkout is a partial clone. Bundling its full upstream history attempted a missing-object fetch that failed on read-only .git; no original Git metadata changed. The measured bundle contains the complete delivery file tree, not unavailable upstream history.
measurementNote: Final tree including validation documentation, refreshed screenshots and the prior size record; the reporting update changes only small JSON/Markdown text.
